candidate_stage: draft release preparation; correction tested, production promotion remains open

limitations: Local preparation and offline inspection only; no model/network/activation latency measured.
Worker process timing includes interpreter startup, imports, input reads and full evidence serialization; helper timing isolates complete candidate preparation plus request construction.
Real CLI timing uses --offline-candidates and therefore excludes request construction and provider inference.
Fresh Python process does not mean cold OS filesystem cache; no system cache flushing or CPU pinning.
Ordinary concurrent host load; rotating order reduces but cannot eliminate timing noise.
Warm-up index construction is separately recorded and excluded from warm distributions.
Cold samples each use a unique initially absent private directory; successful cache writing is required.
Cache validation remains enabled in the frozen runtime; no checksum/type/ownership/metadata validation is bypassed.

limits: One machine under normal concurrent load, no CPU pinning or filesystem cache flush.
Local preparation and CLI measurements are not model response, native loading, or task completion times.
Warm index improvement is small; first index creation is slower.

limitations: Synthetic agent-authored and independently reviewed labels, not human ground truth.
Empty-group NONE/CLARIFY cases have no retrieval target; vacuous all-case coverage is not semantic correctness.
One frozen host catalog; retained skill coverage does not establish improved ranking or model decisions.
Supplemental metadata changes initial model payloads even when required-group recall is unchanged.
Diagnostic timings are single samples in sequential arm processes and do not support causal speed claims.
offline_retrieval.scope: Offline candidate recall only. Model selection, NONE/CLARIFY accuracy, execution success and latency are not evaluated.

live_selection_before_followup_fix.latency_definition: Full helper elapsed_ms including candidate preparation and sequential follow-up requests; median and nearest-rank p95.
limits: One paired live trial per task, not repeated population performance measurement.
Only current/raw and balanced/enriched were evaluated live; retrieval and metadata effects cannot be isolated.
Synthetic task distribution; task labels and catalogs remained frozen. These cases are now consumed evaluation data.
No publisher-versus-competitor live comparison was performed in this experiment.
Token numbers are API-reported usage, not independently tokenized or converted to monetary prices.
Correct refusal or clarification on 20 synthetic cases does not establish general safety or availability.
live_selection_before_followup_fix.recommendation: Retain current/raw as the default; combined balanced retrieval and metadata enrichment did not improve strict task accuracy in this experiment.
live_selection_before_followup_fix.scoring: Exact expected status and one distinct final selected capability per required group, with no extras, duplicates or forbidden selections; proven aliases allowed. Provisional selections are not successful recommendations.

native_utility_pilot.experiment: Native capability selection versus archived advisor assistance
native_utility_pilot.conclusion: No additional selection-quality benefit was observed in this small six-pair diagnostic pilot.

sample.case_selection: Fixed before native outputs; no filtering by archived correctness. Existing synthetic tasks, not a fresh holdout.

subject.advisor_version: Original current_raw runtime underlying the archived live responses

method.order: Sequential; randomized arm order within each pair

timing_boundary.description: Measured native process duration includes host work and local replay overhead. It includes zero fresh TypeSafe inference or network latency; the historical provider latency was not added.

limitations: Six task pairs with one observation per arm are a small diagnostic sample; no general accuracy or performance superiority is established.
Uses hash-verified archived responses from the original f2825 runtime; the corrected implementation and its fresh live quality were not tested.
Equal selection correctness does not establish added agent-quality improvement. Two incomplete archived plans were repaired by the host.
Timing is not fresh advisor latency. Token counts are observed native-host usage, not monetary costs, and cached-token proportions differ.
Measures selection recommendations, not completed user work, first-use catalog export, native connector discovery, or automatic skill loading.
This evidence does not by itself close the ADR-0008 promotion gate.

limits: The 80 repeated tasks are regression data used during diagnosis, not fresh validation.
The 20 independently authored fresh tasks are compound-only and do not measure single-task or negative accuracy.
The prior run used concurrency two; this run uses concurrency one. Latencies are descriptive and support no paired speed claim.
One trial per task; prompt effects cannot be separated from model variability by this design.
Strict scoring requires exact status, all required groups and no extras or forbidden selections; provisional selections receive no final credit.
Alias credit requires exact receipt metadata and a matching complete-bundle identity proof.
Latency is full helper elapsed time including sequential requests; p95 is nearest rank.
Usage is API-reported; no monetary cost estimate or client-loading benefit is inferred.

native_current_inspect.scope: one explicit native Inspect workflow against the current ten-file skill snapshot
limitations: Offline Inspect only; no semantic, compound, automatic activation, other-host or external task completion claim.
Native host still exposed installed skill metadata and reported description truncation.
No model override; exact resolved model name was not emitted.
